# vendor/schwarzwald/kit

A copy of schwarzwald, written by its `sync.py`. Do not edit these files here.

- From: schwarzwald, synced 2026-11-21T03:13:00Z
- Parts: configs, fonts, guards, hooks, lint, rules, tokens, tools
- Excluded (left out of this copy, still in the kit): fonts/fonts.css, hooks/author-guard.sh, hooks/author-guard_test.sh, hooks/markdown-staged.sh, hooks/markdown-staged_test.sh, hooks/pre-commit_test.sh, tools/archive-make.sh, tools/archive-make_test.sh, tools/bulk-read.py, tools/bulk-read_test.py, tools/clone_test.sh, tools/cross-clippy_test.sh, tools/denylist-merge.py, tools/disk_test.py, tools/id-scan.py, tools/land_test.sh, tools/selftest.py
- Change anything: edit `source/` in schwarzwald, run `make deploy` there and commit the
  result here. A fix found here travels to schwarzwald as a patch.
- Verify this copy: `python3 vendor/schwarzwald/kit/check.py`, which needs no schwarzwald checkout.
  `manifest.json` lists a sha256 per file and the files that carry the exec bit.
